title: Jennifer Nettles, Carter Faith, Carly Pearce & Margo Price Lead Soundtrack for ‘Heartland’ Netflix Film
summary: Nettles & Faith are also featured in acting roles in the upcoming film.
contentText: Jennifer Nettles , Carter Faith , Margo Price and Carly Pearce are among the country artists leading the soundtrack to the upcoming Netflix original movie Heartland , starring Jessica Chastain. The soundtrack will release Nov. 13 on Netflix Music, in conjunction with the Shana Feste-directed film’s release the same day. Related Jennifer Nettles on New Musical ‘Giulia: The Poison Queen of Palermo’ Being ‘The Most Rewarding Work I’ve Ever Done’ & Lin-Manuel Miranda’s Advice Carter Faith’s Cherry Valley Gambles Pay Off With A Surprise ACM Visit To Las Vegas Willie Nelson’s 2026 Farm Aid: Best Moments From Neil Young, John Mellencamp, Dave Matthews & More Nettles and Faith are also part of the cast, which centers on retired country singer Misty Jones (Chastain), who is investigating the disappearance of her niece (Faith). In searching for her niece, Jones is forced to grapple with not only her past, but also an unscrupulous music industry. In the film, Nettles portrays a fellow country singer, Winnie Jo Lean. Others appearing in the film include Garrett Hedlund and Wynn Everette. The soundtrack also includes performances from Ross Lynch, Heart Sisters, singer/songwriter Trannie Anderson and more. This isn’t Chastain’s first country music-related project; the actress previously portrayed country singer Tammy Wynette in the 2022 Showtime miniseries George & Tammy , for which she won the Actor Award (then known as a SAG Award) for outstanding female actor in a miniseries or television movie. Nettles, known for both her solo work and her music as part of Sugarland , has previously played roles in films including Harriet , The Righteous Gemstones , Dolly Parton’s Coat of Many Colors and Dolly Parton’s Christmas of Many Colors: Circle of Love .
